stem: Write structures of different chain isomers of alkanes corresponding to the molecular formula \(\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}\). Also write their IUPAC names.

Write structures of different isomeric alkyl groups corresponding to the molecular formula \(\text{C}_5\text{H}_{11}\). Write IUPAC names of alcohols obtained by attachment of \(-\text{OH}\) groups at different carbons of the chain.
solution:
| Structure of \(-\text{C}_5\text{H}_{11}\) group | Corresponding alcohol | Name of alcohol |
|---|---|---|
| (i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\) | \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{OH}\) | Pentan-1-ol |
| (ii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(-)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) (free valency at C-2) | \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{OH})-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) | Pentan-2-ol |
| (iii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(-)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) (free valency at C-3) | \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{OH})-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) | Pentan-3-ol |
| (iv) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\) | \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{OH}\) | 3-Methylbutan-1-ol |
| (v) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2-\) | \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2-\text{OH}\) | 2-Methylbutan-1-ol |
| (vi) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)(-)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) (free valency at C-2) | \(\text{CH}_3-\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)(\text{OH})-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\) | 2-Methylbutan-2-ol |
| (vii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)_2-\text{CH}_2-\) | \(\text{CH}_3-\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)_2-\text{CH}_2\text{OH}\) | 2,2-Dimethylpropan-1-ol |
| (viii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}(-)-\text{CH}_3\) (free valency at C-2 of the butane chain) | \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}(\text{OH})-\text{CH}_3\) | 3-Methylbutan-2-ol |
_note: The book prints each alkyl group as a skeletal structure with the free valency shown as a dangling bond; that dangling bond is rendered here as a trailing dash or a parenthetical statement of which carbon carries it.

stem:
Write IUPAC names of the following compounds :

(i) \((\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}\,\text{CH}_2\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)_3\)

(ii) \((\text{CH}_3)_2\text{C}(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5)_2\)

(iii) tetra-tert-butylmethane

Write structural formulas of the following compounds :

(i) 3,4,4,5-Tetramethylheptane

(ii) 2,5-Dimethyhexane
_note: The book prints (ii) as "2,5-Dimethyhexane" — a misprint for 2,5-Dimethylhexane. Transcribed as printed.

stem:
Write structures for each of the following compounds. Why are the given names incorrect? Write correct IUPAC names.

(i) 2-Ethylpentane

(ii) 5-Ethyl-3-methylheptane
solution:
(i) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\)

The longest chain is of six carbon atoms and not of five. Hence, the correct name is 3-Methylhexane.

(ii) \(\text{CH}_3-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{CH}_3)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}(\text{C}_2\text{H}_5)-\text{CH}_2-\text{CH}_3\)

Numbering is to be started from the end which gives the lower number to the ethyl group. Hence, the correct name is 3-Ethyl-5-methylheptane.
